d:
Prime Minister Narendra Modi interacts with young innovators, entrepreneurs and students, discussing India's ambitions in AI, aerospace, manufacturing and critical infrastructure. From developing indigenous technologies and reducing import dependence to using data and AI to identify students' aptitudes, Modi challenges the next generation to take the lead in building a developed and self-reliant India.
He also shares a light-hearted exchange with a student who says he would contest an election if given the opportunity.
Watch the key moments from the interaction.
